sections.markdown:
## D — Accuracy notes and source flags: vehicle equipment and defensive driving
Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical handbook page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
Headlight aim, taillight and plate-light standards printed on the page before this range were authored in the railroad and interstate section and are not repeated here.
The fuel-saving bullets give money, percentage and gallon estimates; they are kept as printed but flagged dynamic because they are economic estimates rather than legal rules [A02].
The cruise-control fuel saving estimate was left out because it is a marketing-style estimate with no rule attached [A03].
The window-open suggestion for exhaust leaks is a handbook suggestion, not a legal requirement, and is worded as a suggestion [A02].
The tire unsafe criteria and brake requirements are stated as legal standards on the first page of this range [A01].

corpus_stability.reason: The handbook prints a single revision date (Revised May 2025) on its back cover and states laws and fees are subject to change by the General Assembly; no sign of more than one revision per year in the selected pages.
